description: List this workspace's suppressed addresses: recipients that hard-bounced or reported its mail as spam, with the reason and the date. Sends to them are refused (recipient_suppressed). Use it to explain a refused send or before writing to an old contact. Removing an address is a person's decision (dashboard Deliverability page, or the API): this server has no tool for it.
name: list_suppressions
title: List suppressed addresses
